title: 49th Asean summit security ramped up amid possible protests

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Security preparations for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits in November are being ramped up amid possible protests over the controversial US-led Pax Silica initiative, Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Wednesday. US President Donald Trump is expected to attend the major event, although his attendance has yet to be confirmed. While the exact number of world leaders who will attend has yet to be finalized, the heads of the other 10 Asean member states are expected to participate.
